subtitle: Cross-reading of 22/Sep/2026: Polymarket in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT, plus the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) poll released on the night of 21/Sep, registration BR-06004/2026, which is the THIRD national survey with fieldwork closing on the SAME 20/Sep, and the press flow of 22/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 40.50% (USD 11.87M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, up 2.00pp in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT, against the one on 21/Sep at 17:01 BRT. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he rises 0.40pp, to 29.80% (USD 0.89M). POLL: he leads two of the three national surveys with fieldwork closing on 20/Sep, 37% at [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and 40% at BTG/Nexus, against 41% and second place at Palver.
fortes: He leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in two of the THREE national surveys that closed fieldwork on the same 20/Sep: 37% to 33% at [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 21/Sep, registration BR-06004/2026, 2,004 voters interviewed face to face between 17 and 20/Sep with a 2.0pp margin, and 40% to 37% at BTG/Nexus, 2,006 voters by telephone between 18 and 20/Sep.

In the winner contract he rises 2.00pp raw and 1.75pp normalized, and the gap against Flávio Bolsonaro closes from 22.40pp to 19.05pp against the previous day's confirmed reading. The move survives the normalization of the pair, so it is not a spread effect.

On the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) approval ruler the fall stopped and gave back a point: 44% approve against 50% who disapprove, against 43% to 50% in the same house's previous round, with the point inside the 2.0pp margin.
His contract in the winner book has USD 11.87M cumulative, the largest between the two names disputing the price, in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT.
fracos: He remains behind in the winner contract by 19.05pp, with 40.50% against 59.55% for Flávio Bolsonaro.

In the series recorded since 14 April today's value sits 27.00pp below the series high, 67.50%, on 16/Aug, and 6.00pp above the series low, 34.50%, on 25/Apr: the day's rise does not change his position inside his own series.

He loses the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) at Palver, registration BR-00860/2026, 5,000 voters online between 15 and 20/Sep with a 2.8pp margin, by 41% to 42%, and loses its [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing by 43% to 47%.

In the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing against Flávio Bolsonaro he is behind in two of the three houses from the same fieldwork: 41% to 42% at [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and 43% to 47% at Palver, against 46% to 45% at BTG/Nexus.

The administration rating moved the opposite way from approval in the SAME [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) round: negative rose from 38% to 42% and fair fell from 27% to 23%. They are two different questions and they do not add up.
candidates.analise: Lula rose 2.00pp in the winner contract, from 38.50% to 40.50% (USD 11.87M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 17:01 BRT. ⚖️ The raw and the normalized numbers disagree on purpose: the sum of the pair went from 99.40 to 100.05, so normalized he rises 1.75pp and Flávio Bolsonaro gives up the same 1.75pp. The gap closes 3.35pp raw and 3.49pp normalized, which means the move survives normalization. On the poll side the third national survey with fieldwork closing on the same 20/Sep came in, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), which puts him ahead 37% to 33% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and behind 41% to 42% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). With three houses and three methods over the same fieldwork close, two put him ahead in the first round and one puts him behind, and the measured distance ranges from 4 points in his favor to 1 point against. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price move to the poll: it records that Quaest came out at 18:06 BRT on 21/Sep, after the certified reading of 17:01, and that the price moved in the interval between the two certifications.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 59.55% (USD 11.50M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, down 1.35pp in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he rises 1.00pp, to 69.50% (USD 1.06M). POLL: he leads one of the three national surveys with fieldwork closing on 20/Sep, Palver, by 42% to 41%, and is behind in the other two.
fortes: He remains ahead in the winner contract by 19.05pp, with 59.55% against 40.50%, in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT, and his price sits 2.15pp below the series high, 61.70% recorded on 21/Sep.
In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he rises 1.00pp, to 69.50%, in the opposite direction to the winner book on the same day.

He wins the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in two of the three national surveys from the same fieldwork close: 47% to 43% at Palver and 42% to 41% at [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), both declared a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) by the houses themselves.
fracos: He gives up 1.35pp raw and 1.75pp normalized in the winner contract, and the gap certified the previous day, 22.40pp, closes to 19.05pp, and that day's recorded readings had reached 23.80pp, the widest of the series.

He is behind in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in two of the three national surveys with fieldwork closing on 20/Sep: 33% to 37% at [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and 37% to 40% at BTG/Nexus.
He loses the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing at BTG/Nexus by 45% to 46%, and at [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) the distance in his favor is 1 point, half the declared margin.

⚖️ On 22/Sep the Superior Electoral Court accepted the Lula campaign's petition pointing to a network of Instagram profiles boosting content about him, with five days to respond. The rapporteur only ordered the case to proceed and did not conclude that there was any irregularity.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro gave up 1.35pp in the winner contract, from 60.90% to 59.55% (USD 11.50M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT. Normalized the loss is 1.75pp, because the sum of the pair went from 99.40 to 100.05, and it is the normalized figure that describes implied probability. The gap over Lula closes from 22.40pp to 19.05pp, and the readings recorded that day reached 23.80pp, the widest gap of the 158 days in which the series has both sides. ⚠️ The panel's two books moved in opposite directions on the same day: in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he RISES 1.00pp, to 69.50%. On the poll side, the third national survey with fieldwork closing on 20/Sep, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), puts him behind 33% to 37% in the first round and ahead 42% to 41% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), with the house itself declaring a tie. Across the three houses from the same fieldwork his distance to Lula in the first round ranges from 1 point in favor to 4 points against.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the winner contract and 39.45% (USD 0.27M cumulative volume) in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, down 0.80pp in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT. POLL: 6% and third place at [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 21/Sep and 6% and third at BTG/Nexus, against 2% and fourth at Palver.
fortes: Two of the THREE national surveys with fieldwork closing on 20/Sep put him at 6% and in third place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 21/Sep and BTG/Nexus. The house that puts him at 2% and in fourth is the same one that disagrees with the other two at the top.
In the third-place book he remains 3.05pp behind Renan Santos, against 19.95pp in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT and 5.25pp in the 17:01 BRT reading of the same day.
In the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing against Lula, BTG/Nexus measures 43% to 44%, inside two margins.
fracos: He gives up 0.80pp in the third-place book, to 39.45%, and remains behind Renan Santos.
In the winner contract he sits at the book's floor, 0.05%, with USD 5.00M cumulative.
The [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and Palver [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairings against Lula are the harshest on him among the third-way names: 35% to 39% and 35% to 43%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury gave up 0.80pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place book, to 39.45% (USD 0.27M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT, after rising 7.70pp the previous day. His distance to Renan Santos shrank for the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) running, from 19.95pp to 5.25pp and now to 3.05pp. ⚠️ Neither price is a series extreme: in the backup he has already been at 60.30% in this same contract, on 04/Sep. On the poll side, two of the three national surveys that closed fieldwork on 20/Sep put him at 6% and in third place, and Palver puts him at 2% and in fourth, behind Renan Santos. It is the same split that shows up at the top: two houses on one side, one on the other.

fortes: He remains ahead in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place book, with 42.50% against 39.45% for Augusto Cury.
His contract in the winner book has USD 14.07M cumulative, 0.02M short of the largest in the book, which is Tarcísio de Freitas's, with USD 14.09M. He pays 0.75%.

candidates.analise: Renan Santos had the largest fall of the round, 3.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place book, to 42.50% (USD 0.39M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep, 14:40 BRT. haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by the three national surveys with fieldwork closing on 20/Sep, nor tested in a [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round.
